dq<7:0>.function: DQ pads, bidirectional DDR data: write data in (to the Rx slices), read data out (from the Tx slices)

dqs.function: DQS pad, bidirectional strobe: write strobe in (center-aligned, both edges sample DQ); driven as read strobe (from RE) by the Tx

dqsb.function: DQSB pad, complementary bidirectional strobe (replaced by VREF in SE DQS mode; driven as ~DQS on reads)

re.function: RE read-enable pad (true phase); read clock from which DQ/DQS outputs and rclk_core are timed

reb.function: nRE pad (complement); replaced by VREF when re_se=1

zq.function: ZQ pad to external precision RZQ (300 ohm to VSSQ); PU replica legs drive it during calibration

vref_ext.function: external VREFQ pad for DQ receivers / SE strobes (used when vref_int_en=0)

din<31:0>.function: deserialized write data to the core, din<4n+3:4n> = DQ<n> UI3..UI0, updated once per DQS/2 word

din_clk.function: DQS/2 word clock to the core (buffered div_p); core captures din on its rising edge

dout_e<7:0>.function: even read data per DQ from the core (sent while the RE-derived clock is high)

dout_o<7:0>.function: odd read data per DQ from the core (sent while the RE-derived clock is low)

rclk_core.function: RE-derived clock to the core read pipeline (launches dout_e/dout_o and dqs_burst)

rx_en.function: Rx enable: DQ/DQS receivers and strobe distribution (power-down when 0)

rx_mode_um.function: Rx path select: 0 = matched (DQ replica delay + DQS H-tree), 1 = unmatched (DQ direct + DQS repeater chain)

dqs_se.function: 1 = single-ended DQS (DQS vs VREF), 0 = differential DQS/DQSB

vref_int_en.function: 1 = internal VREF DAC, 0 = vref_ext; also powers the ladder/OTA

vref_code<4:0>.function: internal VREF tap, ~34.5%..71.4% of VCCQ in ~1.2% steps

dqs_dly<2:0>.function: Rx DQS delay trim on both strobe phases

dq_dskw<23:0>.function: per-bit Rx DQ deskew, dq_dskw<3n+2:3n> for DQ<n> (training, mainly unmatched mode)

rx_rst_n.function: active-low reset of the DQS/2 divider; release sets the deser word alignment

tm_rxobs.function: test mode: observe div_p on rx_obs

rx_obs.function: test observation output (div_p gated by tm_rxobs & rx_en)

dq_oe.function: DQ output enable; 0 = all DQ driver legs off (Hi-Z); 1 also forces DQ ODT off

dqs_oe.function: DQS/DQSB output enable (preamble..postamble); 1 also forces DQS ODT off

dqs_burst.function: 1 = DQS/DQSB toggle with RE, 0 = DQS low / DQSB high (preamble/postamble)

sr_code<1:0>.function: output slew rate: pre-driver starving current

odt_en.function: on-die termination enable (writes); auto-gated off per group by dq_oe/dqs_oe

odt_code<2:0>.function: ODT strength: ~300/150/100/75/60/50/43 ohm Thevenin for codes 1..7

cal_clk.function: slow calibration clock (~10 MHz, core oscillator): ZQ SAR/counter and DCC comparator/counter; not a high-speed clock

zq_en.function: ZQ calibration enable: VREF divider, comparators, replica legs, PD tracking

zq_start.function: ZQ calibration start pulse (cal_clk domain): starts the PU SAR

zq_rst_n.function: ZQ reset: SAR code 0, PD counter mid-scale

zq_done.function: PU SAR finished (also enables PD tracking)

zq_pu_code<4:0>.function: calibrated pull-up code (readback); internally drives the DQ/DQS PU leg enables

zq_pd_code<4:0>.function: calibrated pull-down code (readback); internally drives the DQ/DQS PD leg enables

drv_ovr_en.function: 1 = driver strength from pu_ovr/pd_ovr instead of ZQ codes

dcc_train.function: DCC training command: 1 = run the duty-cycle loop while RE toggles; 0 = hold the code, clear lock

dcc_lock.function: DCC loop locked (two dither events); also freezes the code

dcc_code<4:0>.function: current DCC code readback (offset binary, 10000 neutral)

ibias.function: ~10 uA reference current from the bandgap; mirrored to ZQ comparators and the VREF buffer

vdd.function: core supply (~1.0 V): Rx back end, clock trees, serializer/deser, calibration logic

vccq.function: IO supply (1.2 V): receivers, level shifters, pre-drivers, drivers, ODT, ESD, ZQ analog, VREF

rx_ctrl.role: Enable/mode control: level-shifts rx_en, dqs_se and internal-VREF select to VCCQ, decodes rx_mode_um into mux selects and strobe clock-gate enables, test observe enable

children.role: dqs_se -> dqs_se_q/dqs_dif_q (VCCQ) for DQS input TG select

rx_ctrl.notes: Static control decode; all outputs are quasi-static mode signals.

rx_vref_gen.role: Internal VREFQ generator: enable PMOS + 32-tap resistor ladder on VCCQ, 5-bit TG tree mux, unity-gain OTA buffer, external/internal select mux, VREF decap

children.role: vref_ext vs buffered internal VREF select

controls.vref_code<4:0>: selects ladder tap t<code>; t<0>=14.5k/42k (~34.5% VCCQ), t<31> ~71.4% VCCQ, 500 ohm/step (~1.2%)
controls.vint_q: 1: internal VREF (ladder on via MM0, OTA enabled, XI3 passes vbuf); 0: vref_ext passed, ladder and OTA off

rx_vref_gen.notes: Ladder: RR0 12k (top) + RR1<30:0> 31 x 500 ohm + RR2 14.5k (bottom), ~29 uA from VCCQ when on. OTA in unity-gain feedback (inn = out). CC0 2p and MOS cap MM1 decouple vref_rx. Static bias; not on the high-speed path. In nf_io_top vref_ext arrives through the VREF pad cell (XI12 io_pad_in).

vref_mux32.role: 32:1 binary-tree analog TG mux (thick-ox, VCCQ) for VREF tap selection

controls.s<4:0>: binary tap index (s<0> = LSB at the leaf level); sb<4:0> are the complements

vref_mux32.notes: Each level halves the candidates; odd taps on d1, even taps on d0. Static.

vref_buf_ota.role: Two-stage Miller OTA (NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS second stage), thick-ox on VCCQ, with power-down; used as unity-gain VREF buffer

controls.en: enable (MM9 pulls net06 to VCCQ when en=0)
controls.enb: power-down (MM8 grounds bias gate when enb=1)

vref_buf_ota.notes: MM0 diode sets tail (MM1) and 2nd-stage sink (MM7) currents; RR0 5k + CC0 0.8p nulling-resistor Miller compensation.

rx_dqs_path.role: Strobe receive path: DQS/DQSB input TGs with diff/SE select, two complementary receivers (true and complement strobe), VCCQ->VDD level conversion, DQS delay trim, clock gating, matched H-trees and unmatched RPT chains for both strobe phases

children.role: always-on TG on DQS (matches the select TG on the ref side and the DQ input TG)
passes DQSB to ref_m in differential mode
passes VREF to ref_m in single-ended mode
complement-strobe receiver (ref minus DQS), inputs swapped
true strobe gate into matched tree (en_m)
complement strobe gate into matched tree (en_m)
true strobe gate into RPT chain (en_u)
complement strobe gate into RPT chain (en_u)
unmatched RPT chain, true strobe -> ckt_u<8:0>
unmatched RPT chain, complement strobe -> ckc_u<8:0>

controls.dqs_se_q: 1: VREF drives ref_m (single-ended DQS); dqs_dif_q is its complement (1: DQSB drives ref_m)
controls.dqs_dly<2:0>: strobe trim delay, same code on both phases

rx_dqs_path.notes: Complement strobe is made by a second identical receiver with swapped inputs (not an inverter) so rise/fall sampling clocks have matched latency; in SE mode the complement receiver compares VREF vs DQS. XI0 is an intentionally always-on TG (en tied vccq, enb tied vssq) matching XI1/XI2 and the DQ-slice input TG. Only one distribution network toggles at a time. In nf_io_top dqs/dqsb come from the pad_rx outputs of the two io_dqs_slice pad cells (same io_pad_bidir as DQ), so the DQS input sees the same pad loading as DQ.

rx_dq_slice.role: Per-DQ receive slice: input TG, VREF-referenced receiver, VCCQ->VDD conversion, per-bit deskew, matched replica delay, mode muxes for data and both strobe phases, rise/fall DDR samplers, 1:4 deserializer (instantiated in io_dq_slice)

children.role: always-on input TG, matches the DQS input TG
replica of DQS clock gate + H-tree delay (matched mode)
rise strobe select: H-tree leaf (d0) vs RPT tap (d1)
fall strobe select: H-tree leaf (d0) vs RPT tap (d1)

controls.selu: 0 = matched (replica data + H-tree strobes), 1 = unmatched (direct data + RPT taps); selub is its complement and also gates the replica

rx_dq_slice.notes: Matched path is a structural copy of the strobe path: same TG, receiver, ls_dn and dly_trim3 cells, then dq_match_dly (ckgate + 3 ckbuf) replicating ckgate + root/branch/leaf of rx_dqs_tree, and the same mux2_hs cell on data and strobe. In unmatched mode the replica is bypassed and clock-gated. Fall sampler clock ckf also retimes the rise sample inside the deser. In nf_io_top the dq input is the secondary-protected pad node pad_rx of the shared bidirectional pad cell (io_dq_slice/XI0), so the DQ Tx driver and ODT legs load the same pad.

dq_match_dly.role: DQ replica delay line matching DQS clock gate + 3-level H-tree (gate, root, branch, leaf ckbuf with lumped replica load caps)

children.role: replica of the DQS-path clock gate (en = selub)

controls.en: gates the replica off in unmatched mode (power)

dq_match_dly.notes: CC0 17f / CC1 13f emulate fan-out-3 (two extra ckbuf inputs + wire) seen by the real root/branch; CC2 5f equals the tree leaf wire cap.

rx_dqs_tree.role: Matched DQS distribution: 1->3->9 buffered H-tree of ckbuf with lumped wire caps; leaves 0..7 to DQ slices, leaf 8 to the divider slice
rx_dqs_tree.notes: Equal depth (3 ckbuf) and equal fan-out to every leaf; replicated on the DQ side by dq_match_dly.

rx_rpt_chain.role: Unmatched DQS distribution: 9 repeaters (rpt_buf) with pi-RC wire segments; the tap after each repeater drives one slice directly
rx_rpt_chain.notes: Latency increases monotonically from tap<0> to tap<8>; no DQ-side replica, so per-bit DQ deskew/training absorbs the skew in unmatched mode.

rx_samp_pair.role: DDR sampler pair: rise-edge sampler on ckr, fall-edge sampler on ckf (complement strobe)

rx_saff.role: StrongARM sense-amp flip-flop: always-on TG + inverter make delay-matched d/db, StrongARM latch (lvt), NAND SR latch
rx_saff.notes: Evaluates on ck rising, precharges (MM7-MM10) while ck low; son falls when d=1, so q=1. The MM12/MM13 TG intentionally matches the inverter delay of the db side. SR latch holds during precharge.

rx_ckdiv_slice.role: Deser clock slice: mode mux for strobe leaf/tap 8, divide-by-2 toggle flop, div_p/div_n buffers, rclk_div driver to core

children.role: matched/unmatched strobe select (same cell as bit slices)

controls.selu: selects leaf 8 of the H-tree or tap 8 of the RPT chain
controls.rst_n: divider reset (q=0: div_p low, div_n high)

rx_ckdiv_slice.notes: Divide-by-2 feedback loop qb -> d. div_n is derived from qb, one inverter later than q, which is tolerated because the deser capture window is one full DQS period. rclk_div is exported as din_clk at nf_io_top.

rx_obs_buf.role: Test observation gate/driver for the deser clock

dly_trim3.role: 3-bit binary cap-load delay trim: two lvt inverters with 1x/2x/4x switched MOS-cap loads on the middle node

controls.code<2:0>: switches MM3/MM4/MM5 MOS caps (m=1/2/4) onto net05; larger code = more delay

dly_trim3.notes: Used in both DQ (dskw) and DQS (dqs_dly) paths so the code-0 delay matches.

mux2_hs.role: NAND-NAND 2:1 mux, z = s ? d1 : d0; same cell on data and strobe paths for delay matching
mux2_hs.notes: Two-level NAND path is identical for d0 and d1.

rx_amp_bz.role: Bazes complementary self-biased differential receiver (thick-ox, VCCQ) with power-down

controls.en_q: enables NMOS tail (MMNE) and releases nbias
controls.enb_q: enables PMOS tail (MMPE); when high, MM1 clamps out low

rx_amp_bz.notes: nbias is the self-bias feedback node driving both tail devices; out is non-inverting w.r.t. inp and not full-swing (squared by rx_ls_dn). Used for DQ (inn=VREF) and for both DQS phases (swapped inputs).

rx_tg_q.role: Thick-oxide transmission gate on VCCQ (input select / delay matching)
rx_tg_q.notes: Instances with en tied to vccq / enb to vssq are permanently on (matching elements).

rx_ls_dn.role: VCCQ->VDD down level converter: VCCQ inverter then thick-gate inverter on VDD
rx_ls_dn.notes: First stage squares the receiver output to full VCCQ swing; second stage uses hv devices so its gate tolerates VCCQ.

amux2_q.role: Thick-oxide TG 2:1 analog mux on VCCQ, z = s ? d1 : d0

rpt_buf.role: Two-stage lvt repeater for long strobe/clock wires

tx_re_rx.role: RE/nRE input receiver: input TGs with diff/SE select, Bazes receiver, dummy complementary receiver for input-load symmetry, VCCQ->VDD conversion

children.role: always-on TG on RE (matches the select TGs)
passes nRE to ref_m in differential mode
passes VREF to ref_m in single-ended mode
dummy receiver with swapped inputs, output unused (load balance)

controls.re_se_q: 1: VREF is the reference (SE RE); re_dif_q: 1: nRE is the reference

tx_re_rx.notes: XI5 output net011 is intentionally unused: it only equalizes the capacitive load presented to RE and nRE. In nf_io_top re/reb are the secondary-protected pad nodes re_rx/reb_rx and vref is the internal/external VREFQ (vref_rx), shared with the DQ receivers.

tx_dca.role: Duty-cycle adjuster: inverter with code-enabled binary PU/PD auxiliary legs (asymmetric edge strength) + output inverter; offset-binary decode

children.role: PU leg enable decode pen_b<i> = ~(code<4> & code<i>)

controls.code<4:0>: offset binary: code<4>=1 enables PU legs (m=8/4/2/1 on code<3:0>) -> faster x rise -> earlier out fall -> lower duty; code<4>=0 enables PD legs on ~code<3:0> -> earlier out rise -> higher duty; 10000/01111 neutral

tx_dca.notes: CC0 6f on x sets the edge rate the legs act on. Intentional rise/fall asymmetry is the adjustment mechanism.

tx_rpt_chain.role: Global clock repeater (RPT) chain: 4 repeaters with pi-RC wire segments from RE pad area to the byte

tx_sr_bias.role: Slew-rate bias generator: resistor-referenced NMOS mirror, sr_code-switched current DAC into PMOS diode (vbp_sr), mirrored into NMOS diode (vbn_sr)

controls.sr_code<1:0>: adds 1x (bit0) and 2x (bit1) to the base 2x mirror current; higher code -> more pre-driver current -> faster output edges

tx_sr_bias.notes: Always on (no enable). srb_q<1:0> unused. CC0/CC1 decouple the bias lines distributed to all slices. Lives in io_bias; vbp_sr/vbn_sr go to every DQ/DQS pre-driver.

tx_ctrl.role: TX control: level-shifts enables and drive codes to VCCQ, gates PU/PD leg enables with dq_oe / dqs_oe, generates DQS/DQSB even/odd patterns from dqs_burst
tx_ctrl.notes: pu_en_* is active-high (NAND in pre-driver), pd_dis_* is active-high disable (NOR in pre-driver). Unused LS complements: net010, net011, pucb_q<4:0>, pdcb_q<4:0>. dqs_burst is launched by the core on rclk_core and retimed inside the DQS slices, so its buffering here is not timing-critical. In nf_io_top pu_code/pd_code come from drv_code_mux (ZQ result or override) inside io_ctrl.

ck_split.role: Clock phase splitter: 2-inverter true path and TG+inverter complement path with matched delay
ck_split.notes: ck non-inverted, ckb inverted; the always-on TG MM4/MM5 replaces one inverter delay on the ckb side.

tx_ser2.role: 2:1 DDR serializer: even and odd retime flops on ck falling (ckb rising), half-cycle latch on the odd path, clocked TG mux and output buffer

children.role: odd half-cycle latch, transparent while ck high

tx_ser2.notes: ck high selects qe (even), ck low selects qol (odd). qe changes at ck fall and is stable while selected; qol changes during ck high and is stable during ck low, so the mux output is glitch-free. One clock cycle of latency.

latch_tg.role: Static TG D-latch, transparent when en=1

controls.en: transparent when high (enb complement drives keeper TG MM2/MM3)

latch_tg.notes: Half-cycle latch on the odd path of tx_ser2 (en = ck): holds the odd bit through the ck-low phase.

ls_up_hs.role: High-speed VDD->VCCQ cross-coupled level shifter for serialized data (lvt input inverter, hv latch, hv output inverter)
ls_up_hs.notes: Ratioed latch gives unequal rise/fall delay (duty distortion on the data path).

tx_predrv_leg.role: One pre-driver leg: NAND(data, pu_en)+inverter+current-starved inverter for the PMOS gate; NOR(data, pd_dis)+inverter+current-starved inverter for the NMOS gate

controls.vbp_sr: PMOS starving bias of the final stages (output slew)
controls.vbn_sr: NMOS starving bias of the final stages (output slew)

tx_predrv_leg.notes: pg = NAND(ds_q, pu_en), ng = NOR(ds_q, pd_dis); disabled leg gives pg=1, ng=0 (Hi-Z). MM0/MM3 and MM4/MM7 are the starving devices.

tx_drv_unit.role: Unit output leg: thick-ox PMOS pull-up + series poly R, thick-ox NMOS pull-down + series poly R
tx_drv_unit.notes: Series resistors linearize the output impedance.

ckbuf_x8.role: Two-stage lvt clock buffer, 2x ckbuf strength

tx_rpt.role: Two-stage lvt repeater for long clock wires

tie_hilo.notes: Provides constant odd-phase DQS/DQSB pattern bits.

nand2_q.notes: Pre-driver PU gating (a = data) and static code gating.

esd_io_pad.role: IO pad ESD cell: GDPMOS to VCCQ and GGNMOS to VSSQ (primary, gate-coupled through 10k), 200 ohm series R and secondary GGNMOS on the receiver side
esd_io_pad.notes: MM0 (pch_hv, gate to VCCQ via RR0) and MM1 (nch_hv, gate to VSSQ via RR1) are off in normal operation; MM2 is a gate-grounded secondary clamp protecting receiver gate oxide (CDM). Used in io_pad_bidir (DQ, DQS, DQSB) and io_pad_in (RE, nRE, VREF_EXT); the receivers tap pad_rx, the drivers and ODT attach at pad.

esd_prim.role: Primary-only pad ESD (GDPMOS + GGNMOS) for the ZQ pin
esd_prim.notes: ZQ pad (nf_io_top/XI13): primary clamps only, no series R (calibration accuracy).

esd_rc_clamp.role: RC-triggered active rail clamp: 500k/1p trigger, 3-inverter driver, large thick-ox NMOS clamp (MMclamp)
esd_rc_clamp.notes: Normal operation: net05 = vtop -> clamp gate low (off). Fast ESD ramp holds net05 low for ~0.5 us -> clamp on. Two instances in esd_rail: VCCQ-VSSQ and VDD-VSS.

esd_b2b.role: Back-to-back diode-connected thick-ox NMOS pair coupling VSS and VSSQ
esd_b2b.notes: Conducts only when the grounds separate by more than a Vt.

odt_leg_pin.role: Per-pin termination: 3 binary PU legs (pch_hv + 480/240/120 ohm) to VCCQ and 3 PD legs (nch_hv + R) to VSSQ, center-tapped at the pad
odt_leg_pin.notes: Unit leg ~600 ohm each side; Thevenin at VCCQ/2. One per pad cell (io_pad_bidir/XI2); gates come from odt_ctrl, which forces the legs off while that pin group drives.

zq_cal.role: ZQ calibration: VCCQ/2 reference, PU replica legs on the ZQ pin vs external RZQ with comparator + 5-bit SAR, PD replica legs against an internal PU copy with comparator + up/down tracking counter, code-to-gate level shifting; codes go to the DQ/DQS driver strength

children.role: PU comparator: VREF vs ZQ pin
PU replica legs driving the ZQ pin
internal PU copy + PD replica legs (node npd)

controls.zq_en: powers VREF divider, comparators (via enb_q) and enables replica gates

zq_cal.notes: Two feedback loops. PU: SAR code -> gate driver -> replica PMOS legs into the ZQ pin against external RZQ -> comparator (out=1 when ZQ > VREF, i.e. PU too strong) -> SAR clears the trial bit; 5 decisions after start, then zq_done. PD: counter code -> gate driver -> PD replica legs against an internal copy of the calibrated PU at npd -> comparator (out=1 when npd > VREF, PD too weak) -> count up; runs continuously once zq_done (dithers +/-1 LSB). pu_g<4:0> and pd_gb<4:0> gate-driver outputs are unused; the counter hold input is tied to vss. MM0 is the PMOS diode receiving ib_zq, giving the comparator tail bias. In nf_io_top zq_clk is the shared slow calibration clock cal_clk; pu_code/pd_code feed io_ctrl (drv_code_mux -> tx_ctrl -> leg enables of all DQ/DQS drivers) and are also read back as zq_pu_code/zq_pd_code. Replica unit is 1/8 of the driver unit, so the calibrated code gives Rpu = RZQ/8 at the pad (37.5 ohm for RZQ = 300 ohm).

zq_vref.role: Switched resistive VCCQ/2 divider with decap

zq_cmp.role: Static two-stage comparator (PMOS input pair, NMOS mirror, NMOS CS second stage) on VCCQ with enable, plus VCCQ->VDD level shift
zq_cmp.notes: out = 1 when inn > inp (inverting with respect to inp). Used with inp = VREF.

zq_sar5.role: 5-bit SAR register: one-hot pointer shift register ph<5:0>, per-bit set/decide/hold logic, code flops, done flag

children.role: next-code OR of the three terms

zq_sar5.notes: Sequence: ph<5> (start) sets code=10000; during ph<i> bit i is on trial and at the end of ph<i> it is kept if cmp=0 (cmpb=1) while bit i-1 is set; after ph<0> done=1 and the code holds. Feedback: code<i> -> hold term -> next code. phb<5:0>, codeb<4:0>, doneb unused.

zq_gate_drv.role: Code-to-replica-gate driver: VDD->VCCQ level shift, NAND with enable (active-low gate gb_q), inverter (active-high g_q)

children.role: g_q = code & en_q for NMOS legs

zq_gate_drv.notes: cqb<4:0> unused. Each instance uses only one of g_q / gb_q.

updn_cnt5.role: 5-bit synchronous saturating up/down counter (XNOR propagate, AND carry chain, XOR next state), reset to 10000, enable and hold

children.role: ckn: counter updates on clk falling

updn_cnt5.notes: Feedback through code<4:0> -> XNOR/XOR. Saturates at 11111 (up) and 00000 (down). net012 (bit-4 qb) and cqb<3:0> unused. Shared by DCC and ZQ-PD. Two instances: zq_cal/XI9 (PD tracking, hold tied to vss) and dcc_ctrl/XI2 (DCC code, hold = dcc_lock).

sa_cmp.role: StrongARM latched comparator with NAND SR latch
sa_cmp.notes: q = 1 when inp > inn at the clk rising edge. Used as the DCC comparator (dcc_ctrl/XI1), strobed by the gated calibration clock upd_clk.

dffs_tg.role: Static TG master-slave DFF with active-low set and qb
dffs_tg.notes: Bit-4 flop of updn_cnt5, so the counter resets to 10000.

xor2_x1.role: Static CMOS XOR2 (12T, internal input inverters)

xnor2_x1.role: Static CMOS XNOR2 (12T, internal input inverters)

inv_x1.notes: Used inside dff_tg/dffr_tg (Rx deser, DQS/2 divider, Tx serializer) and in control/calibration logic.

inv_x2.notes: Static control buffers (rx_ctrl, tx_ctrl, drv_code_mux, rx_obs_buf).

inv_lvt_x2.notes: HS inverter: ckgate, dly_trim3, rx_saff, tx_ser2 output, latch_tg, tx_dca output.

nand2_x1.notes: On the HS path inside dffr_tg of the DQS/2 divider; elsewhere static/calibration logic.

nor2_x1.notes: On the HS path inside dffr_tg of the DQS/2 divider; elsewhere DCA decode, ODT gating, counters.

nand2_lvt.notes: ckgate, mux2_hs and rx_saff SR latch.

ckbuf.notes: Rx H-tree, DQ replica delay, divider buffers, Tx tree branches/leaves, DCA input buffer.

ckgate.notes: Rx strobe gating (matched/unmatched) and the DQ replica gate in dq_match_dly.

dff_tg.role: Static transmission-gate master-slave positive-edge DFF with local clock inverters and keeper loops
dff_tg.notes: Rx deserializer flops and Tx serializer even/odd flops.

dffr_tg.role: Static TG master-slave DFF with active-low asynchronous reset (NAND in master, NOR in slave) and qb output
dffr_tg.notes: DQS/2 divider (HS); ZQ SAR, counters and DCC lock detector (not HS).

ls_up.role: Static VDD->VCCQ cross-coupled level shifter with true/complement outputs
ls_up.notes: Static VDD->VCCQ shifting of enables and codes (rx_ctrl, tx_ctrl, odt_ctrl, zq, vref, sr bias).

rx_deser4.role: 1:4 deserializer per bit: retime the rise sample onto the fall strobe, capture (UI0,UI1) on div_p, re-register them and capture (UI2,UI3) on div_n so all four outputs update together
rx_deser4.notes: (e0, df) is valid for one DQS period after each ckf edge. div_p rise captures UI0/UI1 into p0/p1; the next div_n rise (one DQS period later) captures UI2/UI3 and re-registers p0/p1, so rd<3:0> changes once per word (every 2 DQS periods) and the core can capture it on din_clk (= div_p) rising, mid-window. rd<0> is the first UI. Burst-to-word alignment depends on the divider reset phase (rx_rst_n release). Switch-level check: 11 random words reproduced in UI order.

tx_dq_slice.role: Per-pin Tx core slice: local clock phase split, 2:1 DDR serializer, VDD->VCCQ HS level shifter, 5-leg slew-controlled pre-driver; drives the main-driver leg gates pg/ng of the pad cell

children.role: ck/ckb generation from the tree leaf clock
per-leg pre-drivers with enables and slew bias

tx_dq_slice.notes: The main driver legs moved into the pad cell (io_pad_bidir/XI1 tx_out_drv), so this slice ends at the leg gates: pg<i> low = PU leg on (data 1 & pu_en<i>), ng<i> high = PD leg on (data 0 & ~pd_dis<i>). Output has two buses, so inverting is null; data to pad is non-inverting. ck high sends the even bit, ck low the odd bit (switch-level checked). Same cell for DQS/DQSB with constant patterns.

tx_out_drv.role: Main output driver: 5 binary-weighted PU/PD unit legs (x16/x8/x4/x2/x1) to the pad
tx_out_drv.notes: Strength is selected by which leg gates are enabled (ZQ/override code applied in tx_ctrl, pre-driver per leg). Unit leg = pch_hv 8u + 300 ohm, nch_hv 4u + 300 ohm (ZQ replica unit is 1/8 of this). Pad cap now in io_pad_bidir (CC0).

tx_predrv.role: Pre-driver bank: data buffer plus 5 slew-controlled pre-driver legs sized x8/x4/x2/x1/x1 for driver legs x16/x8/x4/x2/x1
tx_predrv.notes: pg/ng are both low when data is 1 (PMOS on, NMOS off): inverting w.r.t. ds_q, the pad is not. ds_buf is the twice-buffered (true) ds_q fanning out to all 5 legs.

tx_ckbuf_dca.role: RE clock buffer with the in-path duty-cycle adjuster: ckbuf -> tx_dca -> ckbuf_x8 into the RPT chain

controls.dcc_code<4:0>: duty adjust from dcc_ctrl (offset binary, 10000/01111 neutral)

tx_ckbuf_dca.notes: No local monitor tap any more: the DCC detector senses the distributed clock at the tree leaf ck_dcc.

tx_cktree.role: Local Tx clock tree: ckbuf_x8 root, 2 branches, 10 slice leaves (lf<7:0> DQ, lf<8> DQS, lf<9> DQSB), core-clock tap and the DCC sense leaf
tx_cktree.notes: Each branch drives 6 identical ckbuf leaves (branch 0: lf<4:0> + core tap; branch 1: lf<9:5> + DCC sense leaf), so lf_dcc has the same latency/duty as the DQS/DQSB leaves it sits next to.

dcc_det.role: Duty detector: gated clock and complement drive two matched 2-pole RC low-pass filters (50k/0.5p, 50k/0.25p)

controls.en: gates the clock into the detector

dcc_det.notes: Loads the DCC sense leaf but is not in series with any clock. vp ~ D*VDD, vn ~ (1-D)*VDD; tau = 25 ns / 12.5 ns, settles within a few cal_clk periods. net012 is a dummy load (unused) balancing net010/net011.

zq_pu_rep.role: Pull-up replica: 5 binary-weighted pch_hv + series-R legs, unit = 1/8 of the Tx driver PU unit (1u + 2.4k vs 8u + 300 ohm)
zq_pu_rep.notes: Device m and R scale together (m=16 with 150 ohm ... m=1 with 2.4k). Rpu_rep = 8 x Rpu_driver for the same code, so calibrating against RZQ = 300 ohm sets the driver to ~37.5 ohm.

zq_pd_rep.role: Pull-down calibration network: internal PU replica copy (calibrated code) on top of 5 binary nch_hv + R PD legs (1/8 driver unit), node npd

children.role: internal copy of the calibrated pull-up

zq_pd_rep.notes: npd = VCCQ * Rpd / (Rpu + Rpd); the VCCQ/2 target makes Rpd equal the calibrated Rpu.

ib_dist.role: Reference current distribution: NMOS diode on ibias, NMOS sink mirror for ZQ, NMOS->PMOS mirror sourcing the VREF buffer bias
ib_dist.notes: ib_zq sinks current from the PMOS diode in zq_cal; ib_vref sources current into the NMOS diode of vref_buf_ota. All 1:1 (W=2u/L=1u m=2 N side, 4u/1u m=2 P side).

odt_ctrl.role: ODT control: termination enable gated off per pin group while that group drives (odt_en & ~dq_oe, odt_en & ~dqs_oe), VCCQ level shift, code gating, PU (active-low) and PD (active-high) gate drivers for the DQ group and the DQS/DQSB group

children.role: DQ group enable level shift -> oen_d
DQS group enable level shift -> oen_s
DQ PU gate drivers (m=4), pu_gb_d low = on
DQ PD gate drivers (m=4), pd_g_d high = on

controls.dq_oe: forces DQ-group ODT off while DQ drives
controls.dqs_oe: forces DQS-group ODT off while DQS/DQSB drive
controls.odt_code<2:0>: leg selection: ~300/150/100/75/60/50/43 ohm Thevenin for codes 1..7

odt_ctrl.notes: LS complements net010, net016 and ocb_q<2:0> are unused. Termination auto-off avoids fighting the own driver during reads (switch-level checked against random enable/code vectors).

wire_rc_rx.role: Pi RC wire segment model of the Rx strobe RPT chain (8f-120ohm-8f)
wire_rc_rx.notes: Passive; renamed from wire_rc (Rx) to keep cell names unique.

wire_rc_tx.role: Pi RC wire segment model of the Tx RE RPT chain (15f-200ohm-15f)
wire_rc_tx.notes: Passive; renamed from wire_rc (Tx) to keep cell names unique.

mux2_x1.role: Static NAND-NAND 2:1 mux, z = s ? d1 : d0 (standard-Vt control version of mux2_hs)

drv_code_mux.role: Driver strength code source select: ZQ calibration result (default) or register override, per bit
drv_code_mux.notes: VDD-domain; outputs go to tx_ctrl, which level-shifts them and gates with dq_oe/dqs_oe.

dcc_lock_det.role: Bang-bang DCC lock detector: remembers the previous comparator decision, flags a valid dither (decision change) and sets lock after two dither events

children.role: ckn = ~clk (same edge as the code counter)
valid flag (d tied to vdd): ignores the first decision after reset

controls.rst_n: clears lock state (tied to dcc_train in dcc_ctrl)

dcc_lock_det.notes: All flops on ckn (clk falling), aligned with the updn_cnt5 update. qb of XI1/XI2 (net010, net011) unused. Lock is sticky until rst_n goes low.

dcc_ctrl.role: DCC loop controller: gated update clock, RC duty detector on the distributed-clock sense leaf, StrongARM comparator, 5-bit up/down code counter, dither lock detector that freezes the code

controls.dcc_train: 1 = run DCC training (detector, update clock, counter enabled); 0 = code held, lock cleared

dcc_ctrl.notes: Closes the DCC loop through re_clk_path: dcc_code -> tx_dca -> RPT chain -> tree -> ck_dcc leaf -> dcc_det -> sa_cmp -> updn_cnt5 -> dcc_code. Duty > 50% -> vp > vn -> up=1 -> code counts up -> DCA PU legs shorten the high phase (negative feedback). Comparator evaluates on upd_clk rising, counter and lock detector update on upd_clk falling. After two valid dithers dcc_lock=1 drives hold. Comparator qb (net011) unused. Switch-level check with a behavioural duty model: locks within +/-1 LSB from both sides and freezes. Not on the HS path (it only loads the sense leaf).

esd_rail.role: Rail ESD: RC-triggered clamps VCCQ-VSSQ and VDD-VSS, back-to-back diodes VSS-VSSQ

io_pad_bidir.role: Bidirectional pad cell (DQ, DQS, DQSB): primary + secondary ESD, main PU/PD driver legs, ODT legs, pad cap

children.role: primary clamps + 200 ohm / GGNMOS secondary to pad_rx

io_pad_bidir.notes: Two directions: pad -> pad_rx (receive, passive 200 ohm) and pg/ng -> driver -> pad (transmit). Driver and ODT sit on the pad side of the series R; the receiver taps after it. CC0 0.2p pad/bond cap. The same cell on DQS/DQSB keeps strobe and data pad loading equal.

io_pad_in.role: Input-only pad cell: esd_io_pad (primary + secondary) and pad cap; used on RE, nRE and VREF_EXT
io_pad_in.notes: HS for the RE/nRE instances; the VREF_EXT instance (nf_io_top/XI12) carries a static reference. No ODT on these pads.

re_clk_path.role: Read clock path: RE/nRE receiver -> in-path DCA buffer -> global RPT chain -> local clock tree (10 slice leaves, core tap, DCC sense leaf) -> core clock driver

children.role: RE/nRE receiver (diff or SE vs VREF) to VDD
clock buffer with the DCC duty adjuster
4-stage global repeater chain with wire RC
local tree: 10 slice leaves + core tap + DCC sense leaf

re_clk_path.notes: Non-inverting RE -> leaves. The DCA is upstream of the repeaters and tree, so the DCC loop corrects the duty error of receiver + DCA + RPT + tree as seen at ck_dcc, a leaf matched to the DQS/DQSB leaves.

io_dq_slice.role: Per-DQ bidirectional slice: pad cell (ESD, main driver legs, ODT), Rx slice from the protected pad node (receiver, deskew, matched/unmatched select, DDR samplers, 1:4 deser), Tx slice (2:1 serializer, LS, pre-driver)

children.role: pad: ESD + driver legs + ODT legs

controls.selu: Rx matched (0) / unmatched (1) path select (selub complement)

io_dq_slice.notes: The pad is bidirectional: writes come in through XI0 pad_rx -> XI1, reads go out XI2 -> pg/ng -> XI0 driver -> pad. In write mode dq_oe=0 puts all driver legs off and ODT may be on; in read mode ODT is forced off by dq_oe. rd<0> is the first UI of the 4-UI word.

io_dqs_slice.role: Per-strobe pad slice (DQS or DQSB): the same pad cell and Tx slice as a DQ bit; the protected pad node goes up to the strobe receiver

children.role: pad: ESD + driver legs + ODT legs

controls.de: even pattern (dqs_burst for DQS, ~dqs_burst for DQSB)
controls.do: odd pattern (0 for DQS, 1 for DQSB)

io_dqs_slice.notes: Instance names XI0/XI2 match io_dq_slice (XI1, the Rx slice, is absent: both strobe pads feed the differential strobe receiver rx_dqs_path at the top). Output DQS is edge-aligned with DQ by construction (same leaf, serializer, LS, pre-driver, driver).

io_ctrl.role: Control hub (static/slow): Rx enables and mode decode, driver code source select, Tx enable/code & oe gating to leg enables plus DQS patterns, ODT gating; level shifting to VCCQ where needed

children.role: Rx enables, matched/unmatched decode, SE DQS, VREF select, observe enable
Tx enables, code & oe gating, DQS/DQSB patterns
ODT enable/code with auto-off while driving

controls.dq_oe: DQ drive enable (also ODT off for DQ)
controls.dqs_oe: DQS drive enable (also ODT off for DQS)

io_ctrl.notes: All inputs are VDD-domain register/command bits; outputs ending in _q and all leg/ODT gate buses are VCCQ-domain. Switch-level checked (40 random vectors): leg enables = code & oe, ODT = odt_en & ~oe, DQS patterns, enable/mode decode.

io_bias.role: Bias and reference block: current distribution, pre-driver slew bias, VREFQ generator/select

children.role: ibias mirrors to ZQ comparators and VREF buffer
internal VREF DAC + buffer, ext/int select

io_bias.notes: Static; nothing here is on the high-speed path. vref_rx feeds all DQ receivers, the SE strobe reference and the SE RE reference.

nf_io_top.role: Full NAND-flash DDR (Toggle/ONFI style) byte IO: 8 bidirectional DQ slices (pad ESD + main driver + ODT, VREF receiver with matched/unmatched strobe paths, DDR samplers, 1:4 deser, 2:1 serializer + pre-driver), bidirectional DQS/DQSB pads, DQS strobe receiver/distribution and DQS/2 word clock, RE/nRE read-clock path with in-path DCA and closed DCC loop, ZQ calibration feeding the driver strength codes, VREF/bias generation, control decode, pad and rail ESD

children.role: control decode / level shift / leg-enable and ODT gating
ZQ calibration engine (PU SAR + PD tracking)
RE/nRE receiver, DCA, RPT chain, Tx clock tree
DCC detector, comparator, counter, lock detect
DQS/DQSB strobe receiver, matched trees and unmatched RPT chains
DQS/2 divider, deser clocks, din_clk driver

controls.rx_en: Rx enable: DQ/DQS receivers, strobe distribution
controls.dq_dskw<23:0>: per-bit Rx deskew (3 bits per DQ)
controls.dq_oe: DQ driver enable (and DQ ODT off)
controls.dqs_oe: DQS/DQSB driver enable (and DQS ODT off)
controls.drv_ovr_en: driver strength from override instead of ZQ

nf_io_top.notes: Bidirectional pads: dq<7:0>/dqs/dqsb appear as inputs (write data/strobe) and outputs (read data/strobe). Two Rx paths coexist, chosen by rx_mode_um: matched (DQ through dq_match_dly, DQS through H-trees) and unmatched (DQ direct, DQS through the 9-tap repeater chain, tap n -> DQ<n>). Feedback loops: DCC (re_clk_path XI3 -> ck_dcc -> dcc_ctrl XI4 -> dcc_code -> XI3), ZQ PU SAR and PD tracking inside XI2, and the ZQ code path XI2 -> XI0 -> leg enables of XI7/XI8/XI9 (open loop at run time). Unused by design: ckc_m<8>, ckc_u<8> (dummy leaf/tap of the complement strobe). MM0/MM1 are MOS decaps. Not on the HS path: io_ctrl, io_bias, zq_cal, dcc_ctrl, esd_rail, esd_prim, rx_obs_buf.
